versions.content: Support of Container Pdus Type: valid Description: The System Template shall support the definition of Container Pdus. Rationale: It shall be possible to define that one Container Pdu shall transport several contained Pdus. Dependencies:  5 34 of 42  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 213: AUTOSAR_RS_SystemTemplate Requirements on System Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Use Case: Routing of Pdus from a network onto a network with higher payload possibility (e.g. CAN onto CanFD or Ethernet). Supporting Material: 
